snippet.title: HERE COMES THE HORDE | Incremental Auto-Battler Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
PLAY THE DEMO: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5066010/Here_Comes_the_Horde

We're thrilled to finally reveal our new game, Here Comes the Horde! It is an auto-battler incremental game where you send huge armies to defend your castle against hordes of undead enemies led by a formidable necromancer. Survive their attacks, unlock new units, grow stronger, and fill the screen with your troops.

FIND OUT MORE
